sloka: हरीनेव सुसङ्क्रुद्धा हरयो जघ्नुराहवे ।राक्षसाश्चापि रक्षांसि निजघ्नुस्तिमिरे तदा ।। ६.५५.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: harīneva susaṅkruddhā harayo jaghnurāhave ।rākṣasāścāpi rakṣāṁsi nijaghnustimire tadā ।। 6.55.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Then in that darkness and in anger Vanaras went attacking Vanaras and Rakshasas also attacked Rakshasas (not knowing).
